original: Before you is a large brass plate set into the stone floor.  The plate has unknown magical runes carved in it.  A voice from deep within the tower echos,                  'Welcome to the tower of the Gate Keeper'.
translation: 你面前是一塊嵌在石地板上的巨大黃銅板,板上刻著不明的魔法符文。一個聲音從高塔深處迴盪而來：「歡迎來到守門者的高塔」。
note: 專有名詞依 glossary 音譯統一(硬規則 4)。

original: This room lies within the top of the tower and large windows in all directions give a dizzying view of all the land.  The Gate Keeper stands before you, 'One of these 4 gates will lead you to a distant island.  The others ???'
translation: 這個房間位於高塔頂端,四面的大窗讓你俯瞰整片令人目眩的大地。守門者站在你面前：「這四道門其中一道,將帶你前往一座遙遠的島嶼。其餘的……???」
